purpose: Immutable RPM telemetry compatibility and staleness replay inputs; no acceleration ground truth or torque calibration

units.debug4_5_6: logical motor0/1/2 decoder-observation ages, floor(ageUs/100), -1 unseen, saturated32767

timestamp_limitations.age_time_origin: micros() in servosTricopterLog() after motor/servo mixing
timestamp_limitations.blackbox_time_origin: currentTimeUs passed into taskMainPidLoop() before within-loop operations
timestamp_limitations.nominal_interval_proxy: (tBB-(age+1)*100, tBB-age*100] excludes unknown within-loop phase offset; not an exact observation timestamp interval
timestamp_limitations.offered_validation_scope: compatibility, causality and staleness behavior with declared phase uncertainty/sensitivity; not observed acceleration truth

motor_test.native_motor_field_caveat: Values below armed idle can encode as158; do not reconstruct exact disarmed external commands from native motor[]

freshness_contract.genuine_new_rpm: new successfully decoded eRPM frame; repeated equal values and valid zero count as observations
freshness_contract.not_fresh: cached decode, missing/no-edge/invalid frames, EDT packets or enable handshake
freshness_contract.live_metadata: Current diagnostic metadata is tracked only in TRI_SERVO/TRI_GROUND. A future live observer in other modes needs an explicit reviewed tracking change.
